name: 04-continue-prefill
description: type = 'continue' with continue_prefill on (a Claude-style prefill). openai.js:1320-1331 shifts the first entry off `messages` -- which is newest first, so the message being continued is the newest turn -- prefixes it with assistant_prefill when the source is Claude, and turns it into the continuePrefill control prompt that is appended last (openai.js:1346). Because continue_prefill is on, populateChatHistory skips its continueNudge branch (openai.js:907).
